name: Heal
text: Heal one of your champions in play by 50HP
Remove all status effects.

name: Mist of Despair
text: Take 3 damage counters from any of your champions and distribute them to enemy champions.

name: Crimson Wave
text: Reduce your opponents Mana by 2
You receive 1 mana for every enchantment you have in play.

name: Ancient Script
text: Remove an opponents enchantment.

name: Treason
text: Move all damage counters from one of your champions to another of your champions in play. Note this will count towards your opponets kill score if that destroys the champion.

name: Battle Axe
text: Add plus 30 damage to one of your champions attacks.
Do 10 damage to three of your opponents champions.

name: Reconstruction
text: Discard as many cards as you want from your hand, for each one repair your fortress by 30HP

name: Spirit Chain
text: Choose an opponents champion, this champion cannot attck next turn.

name: Wizardry
text: Draw 3 cards and discard one of them.
Look at the next 5 cards of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

name: Archaeology
text: Put a champion from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Parasite
text: Your opponent loses 1 mana for every card in their hand.
Your opponent must discard two cards from their hand.

name: Decoder
text: Discard as many spell cards from your hand as you wish, gain 2 mana for each one.
Discard one enchantment that’s in play or in your hand and gain 5 mana

name: Mumified
text: Reduces the cost of sacrificing a champion by one this turn.

name: Magic Wave
text: Increase all spirit champions attack by 20 this turn.

name: Thunderstorm
text: Do 10 damage to each of your opponents champions (active or encamped)

name: Vortex of the Damned
text: Shuffle any of your opponents champions with less than 60HP back into their deck.

name: Warrior Idol
text: Attach this card to a champion, This champions attack increases by 10 every turn until it is destroyed or Warrior Idol is removed.

name: Fusion
text: Attach this card to a champion, This champions HP is increased by 20 for each of your active champions of the same color as the champion fusion is attached to. This effect is in play until the champion is destroyed or Fusion is removed.

name: Galachs Will
text: Put a spell card from your discard pile into your hand.
Put an enchantment from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Mystery
text: Remove any spell cards attached to an opponents champion.

name: Grand Shield
text: Reduce any of your opponents attacks by 20 next turn.

name: Rain of Dragons
text: Creatures deal an additional 20 damage with their attacks this turn.

name: Power Source
text: Attach this card to a champion, This champions HP is increased by 10 for every card in your hand until the champion is destroyed or Power Source is removed.
